# LruCache&lt;K, V&gt;

A map that holds at most `capacity` entries and evicts the least recently used.

```rux
pub struct LruCache<K, V> {
    // private fields
}
```

Move-only.

## Type parameters

| Name | Description                                              |
| ---- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `K`  | the key type, which the hash and equality functions take |
| `V`  | the value type                                           |

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>LruCache</code></h3>

```rux
pub func LruCache(
    allocator: Allocator,
    capacity: uint,
    hash: func(K, uint64, uint64) -> uint64,
    equals: func(K, K) -> bool
) -> LruCache<K, V>
```

An empty cache that holds at most `capacity` entries, at least one.

| Name        | Type                                | Description                                            |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`                         | where the storage comes from                           |
| `capacity`  | `uint`                              | how many entries it keeps                              |
| `hash`      | `func(K, uint64, uint64) -> uint64` | how a key is hashed, taking the key and two seed words |
| `equals`    | `func(K, K) -> bool`                | whether two keys are the same                          |

**Returns**: the cache

<h3 id="put"><code>Put</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Put(&var self, key: K, value: V) -> K?
```

Caches `value` for `key` as the most recently used, replacing its value if it has one, and evicting the least
recently used entry when the cache is full.
`value` is moved in. A value it replaces, and the value of an evicted entry, are destroyed once the new one is
in place. Terminates the program when the storage for a new entry cannot be had.

| Name    | Type | Description |
| ------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `key`   | `K`  | the key     |
| `value` | `V`  | the value   |

**Returns**: the key that was evicted, if one was

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Collections/Src/LruCache.rux#L122)
